Sammen med et lille hold kæmpe han sig ind i en vild regnskov, besøger den afsidesliggende landsby Mupun, vandrer op i Torricelli-bjergene for at bestige det højeste punkt, Mount Sulen, og leder efter verdens mest sjældne dyr: den sorte trækænguru. programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cement the Case
programme.desc: In 1990, Shirley Andronowich's body was found mutilated. Eyewitnesses told police she had a fight with her husband the night before, but forensic evidence proved that he had nothing to do with her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Telltale Tracks
programme.desc: The disappearance of Philadelphia college athlete Aimee Willard is investigated after her car is found on the roadside. When her body is found, the police find unusual marks and DNA evidence that eventually lead to her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Voice from Beyond
programme.desc: When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. But the body had been placed in the barrel 30 years earlier. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Similar Circumstances
programme.desc: Robert Sims returns home after working the night shift and finds his wife unconscious on the kitchen floor. Their son is fast asleep in an upstairs bedroom, but their six-week-old daughter, Heather, is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of Truth
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence, but investigators cannot find a conclusive link to their prime suspect. To solve the puzzle, an FBI analyst designs a unique experiment.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeing Red
programme.desc: In 2005, the body of young mother Summer Baldwin was found in a suitcase in a Texas landfill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Accident or Murder
programme.desc: Janice Johnson was found dead at the foot of her basement stairs. Police in Nova Scotia had to unravel the circumstances surrounding Janice's death and answer the question: Was it an accident or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of a Killer
programme.desc: In 2003, Kathy Lorick was murdered on a Concord, California jogging trail while talking to her husband on her mobile phone.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Haunting Vision
programme.desc: Fire engulfs the home where Lori Keidel and her siblings were left alone while their father went to the laundromat. Years after her mother's disappearance, Lori tells police she witnessed her mother's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fate Date
programme.desc: In 2004, Rebecca Barney and her soon-to-be ex-husband Fred were found shot to death in their Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, which had been set on fire.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wired for Disaster
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance

programme.title: Happy Days: Richie's Car
programme.desc: Richie persuades his father to let him have his own car and Fonzie comes up with just the car for him, a hot rod named "Love Bandit," which turns out to be hot in more ways than one.

programme.title: Happy Days: Not With My Sister You Don't
programme.sub-title: Not With My Sister You Don't
programme.desc: Richie's surprise over little sister Joanie's first real date turns to shock when he learns it's with Spike, a pint-sized replica of his Uncle Fonzie.

programme.title: Happy Days: Richie Moves Out
programme.desc: Hoping for more privacy, Richie moves out of the Cunningham home to share an apartment with his brother and soon discovers it's not the paradise he expected.

programme.title: Happy Days: You Go To My Head
programme.desc: Richie's fears get the best of him while he's reading a book on abnormal psychology and it drives him to secretly see a psychiatrist.

programme.title: Happy Days: Wish Upon a Star
programme.desc: Hollywood comes to Jefferson High when Richie wins a dance date with a beautiful movie star in a school raffle.

programme.title: Happy Days: Richie's Flip Side
programme.desc: Richie lets fame go to his head when he takes a turn as a disc jockey at the local radio station.

programme.title: Happy Days: Goin' to Chicago
programme.desc: While in Chicago with their high school choir, Richie, Ralph, and Potsie sneak by their chaperons, wind up on the wrong side of an unsympathetic downtown nightclub owner, and win the sympathy of a kind-hearted cocktail waitress.

programme.title: Happy Days: The Cunningham Caper
programme.desc: Richie is sick in bed with the flu and is bored with eating soup and doing crossword puzzles. But when his family leaves him alone in the house, pandemonium breaks loose when Fonzie, Potsie, Ralph, and a burglar join him.

programme.title: Happy Days: Get A Job
programme.desc: It's a new experience for Richie when he becomes romantically attracted to an "older woman."

programme.title: Happy Days: Cruisin'
programme.desc: Richie, Potsie, and Ralph Malph visit another part of town to meet some girls and find themselves in trouble when the girls' boyfriends show up. Fonzie steps in to save the day.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fearless Fonzarelli Part I
programme.desc: For a television show, the Fonz sets a record by jumping his motorcycle over fourteen garbage cans. He ends up crashing into Arnold's chicken stand, and while recuperating from a broken leg, upsets the regimen of the Cunningham household.

programme.title: Happy Days: Football Frolics
programme.desc: To raise money for the big football game, the boys decide to start their own babysitting service. In Football Frolics, Richie, Potsie and Ralph have their hopes set on seeing the big football game of the year, but tickets can't be found anywhere.

programme.title: Happy Days: Two Angry Men
programme.desc: When Fonzie sets a pigeon coop atop the Cunningham garage and the roof caves, Mr. Cunningham sues to collect damages. In Two Angry Men, Laverne and Shirley prevail upon Fonzie to care for a coop of pigeons.

programme.title: Happy Days: Sight for Sore Eyes
programme.desc: After reading too many foreign car manuals, Fonzie is plagued with headaches and is forced to wear glasses for a few weeks, but fears glasses aren't cool.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie Loves Pinky Part II
programme.desc: The Malachi brothers sabotage Pinky's car the night before the demolition derby.

programme.title: Happy Days: The Physical
programme.desc: A short-tempered sergeant loses his tenuous grasp on discipline when the Fonz reports to the army recruitment center soon after draftees Richie, Ralph and Potsie check in for physicals.

programme.title: Happy Days: The Apartment
programme.desc: Personality quirks begin to fray nerves after best friends Richie, Ralph, and Potsie rent an apartment together.

programme.title: Happy Days: Hard Cover
programme.desc: Richie and Fonzie must think fast to outwit a tough housemother after they're caught past curfew in the college girls' dormitory.

programme.title: Happy Days: Hollywood Part 2
programme.desc: Soon after getting the bad news that the studio deemed his James Dean impression obsolete, and gave Richie's wholesome good looks a contract instead, the Fonz finds a bigger fish to fry.

programme.title: Happy Days: Hollywood Part 3
programme.desc: Richie must choose either a 5-year Hollywood contract or college in Milwaukee while the Fonz accepts the California Kid's challenge to perform a dangerous water ski jump...over a shark!

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonsilectomy
programme.desc: Forced to spend the night in the hospital's children's ward, Fonzie worries more about who will be making time with his girl at the Halloween party than the tonsillectomy he's scheduled for the next morning.

programme.title: Happy Days: My Fair Fonzie
programme.desc: Snobby Cynthia Holmes schemes with her obnoxious cousin, Skippy, to make the Fonz look foolish at a country club soirée.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: D-Day
programme.desc: Mikey's much-planned D-Day tribute parachute jump with 20 paratroopers hits a wall when Joe refuses to fly his DC-3 to the drop zone.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Change of Seasons
programme.desc: When her husband quits after a blowout with Joe, Kelly is put in a terrible position. Will she stay at Buffalo - or will she go? Scott gets the news he must stand down from flying so another co-pilot can fast-track to captain.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Over Seas
programme.desc: Buffalo has to get a CL-215 water bomber to buyers in Korea. So Justin and Cory fly the plane to Vancouver Harbour, where it will be hoisted onto a cargo ship sailing across the Pacific Ocean to its destination a method of delivery no one has ever tried.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Birthday from Hell
programme.desc: A string of bad luck turns chief pilot Arnie's 66th birthday run into the flight from hell - and threatens to spoil his naughty birthday surprise.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Power Crash
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck and Brian watch as a 5,000-pound power unit smash to the ground, denting the Electra and putting it out of commission. Mikey scrambles to manage the crisis while Joe races to England to try and purchase a backup Electra.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Four
programme.desc: As Joe fights a Transport Canada claim against the airline, star pilot Justin is tasked with shipping an 8,000lb generator to a remote town. But a controversial decision results in the DC-4 becoming stranded and frozen solid on a High Arctic airstrip.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Water Wings
programme.desc: In South Korea, Cory and Justin meet the ship delivering Buffalo's water bomber plane to new buyers there. But the boys are frustrated by the buyers' poor planning.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Old Dogs
programme.desc: Engine trouble plagues Buffalo's newest Electra, ZFE, and a standoff between Joe and Transport Canada threatens to close the airline. At the same time, Joe faces a tough decision about his old dog Sophie.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under Pressure
programme.desc: The curse of -40 hits Buffalo pilots Devan and Scott on a food mail flight up the Mackenzie Valley when a mysterious rise in oil pressure threatens to destroy one of the C-46's engines.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Big Plans, Bad Luck

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen: Episode 603

programme.title: Koch'en på toppen: Episode 606

programme.title: Love Island Danmark: Episode 216

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Superfansenes observationer skaber ravage i villaen og især Amalie Marias adfærd ryster Kasper dybt. Og så giver Camilla ikke op på sin Rayan og beviser, at alle tricks gælder i krig og kærlighed.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1815
programme.desc: Kristina fra Middelfart har ringet efter Luksusfælden, fordi hendes kæmpe gæld bare vokser og vokser.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1901

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1902
programme.desc: Nickis tidligere stofmisbrug har fået store økonomiske konsekvenser for ham og hans kæreste Dorthe. For selvom Dorthe har styr på sin økonomi, så sejler Nickis, og dét giver ubalance i forholdet.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1903
programme.desc: I Alsted ved Sorø kæmper Jarl og Camilla en kamp mod tiden, for når deres ufødte barn bliver født om 6 måneder, har parret ikke længere et sted at bo.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1904

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1905
programme.desc: 26-årige Anette har brugt 52.000 kroner på dyre restauranter, gode vine og selvforkælelse det seneste år. Samtidig bor hun alene og skal betale hele forbrugsfesten med lønnen fra sit tjenerjob.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1906
programme.desc: Jan har altid været vant til at give andre skylden for sine økonomiske valg – i hvert fald, når det er gået galt, og dét er det hver gang.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1907
programme.desc: For Pia er livet som alenemor til 5 børn blevet en daglig kamp om at få pengene til at slå til. Men Pia har et job, og hun modtager mange forskellige tilskud fra det offentlige, så hun burde kunne få pengene til at række.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1908
programme.desc: Niels og Anna-Kirstine har alt på spil, for om få måneder løber de tør for penge til at betale deres terminer og afdragene på deres biler.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1911

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1912
programme.desc: I Gerlev i Nordsjælland styrer Karina familiens økonomi med hård hånd, og hun mener ikke, at Janus har noget at skulle have sagt. I hendes øjne er hun kassemester, og Janus er ingenting.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1913
programme.desc: Brian kan godt lide at have det rigtige udstyr – også selvom det er dyrt. Men den luksus er snart fortid, for Luksusfældens eksperter er på vej hjem til ham for at fortælle, at han skal sælge det hele.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 1914
programme.desc: Når Anette er forelsket, lever hun et liv i sus og dus med forbrugslån, nye møbler og god mad. Men bagefter står hun tilbage med regningen, der nu betyder, at hun er havnet i en økonomisk blindgyde.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 512

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 309

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 502
programme.desc: Lenette har tabt sig 55 kilo og føler, at hun har for meget løs hud på mave, bryster og lår. Hun finder derfor en kirurg, foretager alle tre operationer, men det går ikke som planlagt.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 614
programme.desc: 24-årige Bettina har hele livet været ked af sin næse, der i folkeskolen har givet anledning til øgenavne som Pelikanen og H.C. Andersen.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 603
programme.desc: For tre år siden valgte Sarah at få foretaget en brystforstørrende operation i Polen, men efter indgrebet syntes hun, brysterne lignede to kaffeposer med implantater.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 608
programme.desc: I 2011 vælger Sabina at få lavet en brystforstørrende operation. Men allerede få dage efter indgrebet opdager hun, at brysterne hænger.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: Vi møder Connie, der ønskede sig naturlige bryster, men blev rådgivet af sin kirurg til at vælge de største implantater. Nu føler hun, at hun har fået lavet så store bryster, at folk tænker: ”..der kommer brysterne med Connie”

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 612
programme.desc: Efter et større vægttab får 25-årige Michele lavet en maveskindsoperation, men resultatet skuffer slemt, og Michele har fået store problemer med sin livskvalitet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 203
programme.desc: Mød Pia, der efter en brystforstørrende operation fik stafylokokker og måtte gå 6 måneder med kun ét implantat hun først fik ud, da hun fik blodforgiftning.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 610
programme.desc: Sportsglade Jeanette blev for 12 år siden inspireret af en trend i fitnesscenteret, hvor veninderne fik opereret deres bryster større. Modsat veninderne bliver hun ikke glad for sine nye store bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 403
programme.desc: Vi møder Charlotte, der har svært ved at få et forhold til en mand, fordi hun skammer sig over sine silikonebryster, og Katja, som kæmper med gamle tråde fra tidligere operationer i brysterne.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 507
programme.desc: For 10 år siden får Michelle fjernet en godartet cyste bag højre øje. Operationen medfører, at øjenlåget hænger løst nedover øjet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: Mød Louise, der brugte familiens penge på en brystoperation, der endte med at blive en traumatisk oplevelse for hende.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 509
programme.desc: Philip fik som 16-årig brækket næsen i en slåskamp og har siden forsøgt at få den pæn gennem en række operationer i udlandet. Alle operationerne er mislykkedes.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 101

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 302

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 306

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 902

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 103

programme.desc: Nogle deltagere mister besindelsen, da de tørner sammen i en opslidende elimineringsrunde. Kampen om $200.000 og Master Shop-titlen spidser til.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Redemption: Horrormester
programme.desc: Tatovørerne Don Peddicord og Sebastian Murphy er tilbage efter forløsning for horrortatoveringer, deres lærreder hader.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Shawny og Jack
programme.desc: Shawny blev for nylig skilt fra sin mand. Nev og Max hjælper hende med at finde ud af mere om hendes nye kæreste, men det bliver interessant.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Marvin & Austin
programme.desc: Efter flere måneders med sexting med en flot model, vil Marvin møde ham i virkeligheden.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Eric & Lianna
programme.desc: Hvordan finder unge kærligheden i en digital tidsalder? Ofte handler det først om at connecte online med nogen, du ikke har mødt i virkeligheden.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: DeJuan & Tynea
programme.desc: I årevis har DeJuan været lun på Tynea, men da Nev og Kamie optrevler et mysterium med tvillingesøstre, ser de dobbelte problemer for DeJuan.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Sheklia og Talli
programme.desc: En bekymret søn tager kontakt, da morens netkæreste virker lidt for lyssky. Men moren har sine egne hemmeligheder, og da Nev og Max finder fyren.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: It's All about the Big Benjamins, Baby!
programme.desc: Med elskede OG'er og nye hitlistetoppende artister er gruppen viklet godt ind i hinandens penge-moves og uundgåelige rod. Kan ATL genforenes i en tid.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: He Proposed to Both of Us
programme.desc: Leila, en model fra Schweiz, blev betaget, da hun første gang mødte West for fire år siden. Men på det seneste har West ændret adfærd.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Naimah & Maher
programme.desc: Naimah og Maher var klassens klovne, der straks blev BFF. Da Naimah gik ind i lufvåbnet, løb venskabet ud i sandet. Naimah sendte e-mails til Maher.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: We Have Dogs at Home
programme.desc: Neko har været venner med Kara i ti år, så da de begyndte at date for et år siden, stolede han totalt på hende. Men efter Kara blev stripperbarber.

programme.title: The Challenge All Stars: Det er derfor, vi er rivaler
programme.desc: Et par vil tage hævn ved at få den stjerne tilbage, de blev frastjålet i elimineringen, og en Challenger truer med at droppe helt ud af spillet.

programme.title: Ink Master: Hjembydysten
programme.desc: 15 internationale tatovører kæmper for at repræsentere deres hjemby, men først skal de erobre en plads i konkurrencen om 250.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXXI
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness flyver Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal højt i Vild tubing, tager ud på løjperne i Sidste tur og skiller sig ud.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXXII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness sigter Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal helt elendigt i Langt fra målet.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXXIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness beskytter Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Nina Agdal halsen fra Kørende tøjsnore, sigter i det vilde, nye spil Barn, bold.

programme.title: Storytellers: Storytellers Season
programme.desc: Mary J. Blige fremfører tidligere hits og nye sange fra hendes Grammy-nominrede album Growing Pains.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling and Nina Agdal LXVII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness ser Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal farlige stunt med dårligt træ i Svage ramper.

programme.title: Ink Master: Mash Up-mareridt
programme.desc: I den episke kamp mod finalen konkurrerer de sidste fem kunstnere mod hinanden med mashup-tatoveringer.

programme.title: Ink Master: OGs vs. Young Guns
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen løfter de tre finalister sløret for deres Master Canvas-tatoveringer.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling en Lolo Wood CI
programme.desc: In deze Ridiculousness zijn Rob, Steelo en Lolo Wood niet veilig dankzij VERDEDIGINGSRAMPEN.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling en Lolo Wood CII
programme.desc: In deze Ridiculousness pakken Rob, Steelo en Lolo Wood de tissues erbij voor een NIESAANVAL.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling en Lolo Wood CIII
programme.desc: In deze Ridiculousness trekken Rob, Steelo en Lolo Wood de scheenberschermers aan voor GESCHOKT DOOR KINDERVOETBAL.

programme.title: The Challenge All Stars: Det er derfor, vi er rivaler
programme.desc: Et par vil tage hævn ved at få den stjerne tilbage, de blev frastjålet i elimineringen, og en Challenger truer med at droppe helt ud af spillet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Charming Charlie
programme.desc: Kan Charlie charme sig ud af to vrede eks'ers (og Nads') unåde? Chloes usikkerhed tager over, og tre personers tid i villaen er i fare.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Det er sidste aften, og slænget er værter for eventet Geordie-licious! Der er pres på for at levere en fest, som ingen glemmer. Amelia synger.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Carly Aquilino LXXXVII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness tager Rob, Steelo og Carly Aquilino spillet for alvorligt i Old boys-intensitet.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Carly Aquilino LXXXVIII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness holder Rob Dyrdek, Steelo Brim og Carly Aquilino sig oppe i Brystangreb.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LVII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness imponeres Rob, Steelo og gæst Karrueche Tran af nogleEkstremgamle, nægter at spise ved bordet.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LVI
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness disker Rob, Steelo og Karrueche Tran op med nogle smidige kiksere i Køkkengymnaster.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LIX
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness banker Rob, Steelo og Karrueche Tran sig gennem gipsplader i Spartlingstid.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LX
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness finder Rob, Steelo og Karrueche Tran ud af, hvordan man ikke rutsjer ned ad et gelænder i Gelænderstyrt.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Karrueche Tran LXII
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness får Rob, Steelo og Karrueche Tran smagt på noget ost i Stor ost.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Rocsi Diaz XXI
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness efterlader Rob, Steelo og Rocsi Diaz alt glas smadret i Knust glas.

programme.title: Teen Mom Family Reunion: Double Mamma Drama
programme.desc: Spændingerne topper, da skænderier og diskussioner starter i løbet af aftenen. April får alkoholforbud og et graviditetsrygte spreder sig.

programme.title: Teen Mom Family Reunion: Floating Down the River
programme.desc: Mødrene er trætte efter skænderiet aftenen forinden. Cate & April har et følelsesladet møde med Træner B. Briana.

programme.title: Teen Mom Family Reunion: High Altitude, Bigger Attitude
programme.desc: Gruppen mangler fem medlemmer, og mødre & bedstemødre prøver at bevare den gode stemning.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Captain Save A Hoe
programme.desc: Caught in the Act: Utro følger værten Tami, mens hun hjælper de mistroiske med at tage deres utro partnere på fersk gerning.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Hard At Work
programme.desc: Caught in the Act: Utro følger værten Tami, mens hun hjælper de mistroiske med at tage deres utro partnere på fersk gerning.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Shay arbejder meget for at forsøge sin kæreste Tommy, men advarselsflagene hober sig op. Shay er begyndt at tro, at han skjuler noget større.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Kontekstuelle forhold
programme.desc: Jasmine ruller op til Krks event og forsøger at sætte en stopper for Rahseedas tvivl. Sierra drømmer om det perfekte bryllup.

programme.title: Ink Master: Shop Wars: Get the Flock Outta Here
programme.desc: Tatovørshops går i opløsning, idet spændingerne mellem holdkammeraterne intensiveres. Kampen om $200.000 og Master Shop-titlen fortsætter.

programme.title: Ink Master: Shop Wars: På kanten
programme.desc: En af konkurencens meste berygtede veteraner vender tilbage for at ruske op i deltagerne. Kampen om $200.000 og Master Shop-titlen fortsætter.

programme.title: Ink Master Redemption: Slagt ikke min baby
programme.desc: Følelserne løber højt, da de rasende Canvases vender tilbage med en overbeskyttende forælder. Keith Diffenderfer og Aaron Is vender tilbage.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Kiaira og Cortney
programme.desc: Kiaira og Cortney fik et barn... Men Kiaira har aldrig mødt Cortney eller barnet! Nev og Max bliver tilkaldt for at bringe familien sammen.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Angel og Jordan
programme.desc: En dyst på Tinder tændte en gnist hos Jordan, der fik Angel til at afslutte sit forhold og gå efter ham. Da Nev og hans kone, Laura, tager sagen.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Sheila & Rich Dollaz
programme.desc: Nev og Nick Young, aka Swaggy P, prøver at hjælpe Sheila med at finde ud af, om hun har et netforhold til LOVE & HIP HOP's Rich Dollaz.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Mathan & Leah
programme.desc: Nev og hans medvært Kamie Crawford hjælper Mathan med at finde Leah, en pige han har talt med i ti år, Men Leah har en ufattelig hemmelighed.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show: Taylor og Christian
programme.desc: Taylor beder om hjælp efter at være faldet for en fyr, der siger, han gik på hendes high school, men som hun ikke kan huske.

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop Atlanta: Thames The Brakes
programme.desc: Med elskede OG'er og nye hitlistetoppende artister er gruppen viklet godt ind i hinandens penge-moves og uundgåelige rod. Kan ATL genforenes i en tid.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful
programme.desc: Bella troede, at hun havde fundet sin drømmemand i Aaron, men begynder at tvivle, da hun får mistanke om.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing: Tini & Bri
programme.desc: Tini mødte Bri gennem en spirituel gruppe og blev straks tætte. De havde det begge svært og var solstråler i hinandens liv, men det gik galt.

programme.title: Caught In The Act: Unfaithful: You Gave Up the Cookies!
programme.desc: I næsten tre år har Mariah boet sammen med kæresten, der er faderen til hendes søn. Selv om Bobby elsker hende, har Mariah oplevet noget chokerende.

programme.title: Ink Master: Tilbage til tegnebrættet
programme.desc: Kampen om en salon fortsætter, da deltagerne tatoverer dyr fra hjembyen. Nogle må tilbage til tegnebrættet, og slaget er kun lige begyndt.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Bestilte nogen en Gary Beadle?
programme.desc: Ricci tager en snak med Kyle for at diskutere uvenskabet og Sophie og Jordan ankommer til villaen og spreder positiv stemning.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina AgdalX XV
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness hører Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal smerten fra Det lyder smertefuldt, prøver at finde ud af.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Sterling og Nina Agdal LXXVI
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness møder Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal nogle belastede trænere i Læg fløjten på hylden.

programme.desc: I dette afsnit af Ridiculousness flyver Rob, Steelo og Nina Agdal i nogle Hjemmelavede helikoptere, gør rent i Pligtskader og ser.

programme.title: Scorpion: Extinction

programme.title: Scorpion: More Extinction
programme.desc: Team Scorpion arbejder fortsat sammen med deres nemesis, Mark Collins, for at forhindre en hændelse, der kan udrydde menneskeheden. Cabes last minute-beslutning kan føre til en ende på hans karriere.

programme.title: Scorpion: Nuke Kids on the Block

programme.title: Scorpion: Sci Hard

programme.title: Scorpion: Go with the Flo(rence)

programme.title: Scorpion: Faire Is Foul

programme.title: Scorpion: It's Raining Men (of War)

programme.title: Scorpion: Crime Every Mountain

programme.title: Scorpion: A Christmas Car-Roll
programme.desc: Juleaften falder Walter ned ad trappen og slår hovedet. Mens han ligger bevidstløs, træder han ind i en drømmeverden, hvor Team Scorpion aldrig har eksisteret.

programme.title: Scorpion: The Bunker Games
programme.desc: Team Scorpion er nødt til at samarbejde med Tobys nemesis samt hans tidligere forlovede, da de bliver låst inde i en kunstigt intelligent dommedagsbunker, der har til formål at dræbe dem.

programme.title: Scorpion: Lighthouse of the Rising Sun

programme.title: Scorpion: Wave Goodbye
programme.desc: Team Scorpion skal forhindre en tsunami i at ramme et sårbart atomkraftværk, og Toby hjælper i hemmelighed sin tidligere forlovede med at genfinde hendes stjålne identitet.

programme.title: Scorpion: Nerd, Wind & Fire

programme.title: Scorpion: Dumbster Fire
programme.desc: Under en mission der skal forhindre dannelsen af et sort hul, bliver de mentale kapaciteter svækket, så genierne i Team Scorpion bliver til tumper, og Paige må forenkle videnskaben for dem.

programme.title: Scorpion: Dork Day Afternoon

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Mads Frandsen og Fishingbrødrene taler - helt ærligt - om at gå all-in på en særlig interesse og gøre niche-content levende for mange. De deler vilde idéer, store drømme og nomineringerne - før vand, eddike og bluffet sætter smagsløgene på prøve.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.sub-title: Mia Thim, Mads Kolle & Marie Macho
programme.desc: Marie Macho, Mia Thim og Mads Kolle taler - helt ærligt - om drømmen, gennembruddet og livet som upcoming creators. De deler modgang, ambitioner og deres nomineringer - inden ærligheden bliver sat på prøve i den nervepirrende leg 'Sand eller vand'.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Kenderdudet og Peddey ser tilbage på deres lange creator-liv og taler - helt ærligt - om at forblive relevante i en branche i forandring. Bagefter bliver det ekstra varmt, når de presses til at afsløre hemmeligheder i 'Den varme sommerstol'.

credits.actor: Elias Hole & Esther Marie Dettmann Nielsen

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger
programme.desc: no info available

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 309
programme.desc: Renoveringskvartetten rejser til smukke Kinn i Sogn og Fjordane, hvor en fiskerby får en makeover.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 310
programme.desc: Et træt sommerhus i Geilos vinterparadis med udsigt over det fantastiske Hallingskarvet. Huset skal have et solidt løft, fornyet køkkenet og udvidet stuen.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 401
programme.desc: Langt ude i havgabet uden for Helgelands kyst i Norge, finder du den lille ø Myken. Her skal teamet renovere et 100 år gammelt fyr.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 402
programme.desc: Et ubeboeligt mekanisk værksted forvandles til et moderne og industrielt sommerhus helt ud over det sædvanlige! Det endelige resultat er måske den største forvandling, de nogensinde har været med til.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 403
programme.desc: I dag skal fyrene istandsætte en gammel, slidt hytte med panoramaudsigt over den fantastisk flotte Geirangerfjord.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 404
programme.desc: På Norges vestligste øgruppe, Utvær, er en smuk hytte, der desperat har brug for hjælp fra Halvor og teamet. Der skal ske en større forvandling, både ude og inde.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 405
programme.desc: I dette afsnit blander teamet elementer fra områder og rum udendørs og indendørs. Det bliver en hård start, da Gustav ringer til Halvor og siger, at han bliver nødt til at blive hjemme grundet sygdom.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 406
programme.desc: På en kort bådtur uden for Kristiansand finder drengene en lille perle af en hytte, med kun en spytklat over til Danmark. Ole har meget særlige planer for den udvendige del af hytten.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 407
programme.desc: Teamet skal være ekstra kreative i en hytte ved den skønne vinterdestination Sjusjøen, hvor roer og langrendsløber Birgit Skarstein og hendes sambo Martin har et trænings- og ferieparadis.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 408
programme.desc: Denne gang skal to hytter dybt inde i Finnskogen renoveres. Den ene er minimalistisk og nordisk, mens den anden er traditionel og hyggelig.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 409
programme.desc: Teamet tager til Telemarks største sø, Møsvatn. De skal renovere en hytte, og Halvor bruger næsten 100 liter sort maling ude og inde, men alligevel ender hytten med en blød og behagelig atmosfære.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 410
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit rejser teamet til Harstad for at renovere en hytte til Den Norske Turistforening. Det bliver et meget særligt projekt, der tager flere uger.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 501
programme.desc: For første gang i Skønne ombygninger rejser fyrene til udlandet, nemlig ned til de franske vinstokke. Her renoverer de et charmerende sommerhus for et norsk par, i hjertet af Provence.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 502
programme.desc: I andet afsnit af sæsonen rejser vores renoveringsgenier til en hytte uden for den idylliske by Lillesand. Det bliver en uforglemmelig uge med et kreativt og overraskende resultat.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 503
programme.desc: Teamet har aldrig før haft at gøre med en uidentificerbar flyvende genstand, men én gang skal jo være den første. Hold på hat og briller, for deres projekt i Nevlunghavn bliver en udenjordisk oplevelse.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 504
programme.desc: Denne uge påbegynder teamet en renovering, som ejerne ikke har efterspurgt. De tilbringer seks dage ved Værøy fyr uden for Lofoten på en opgave, som ejerne tror vil tage fem til seks år.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 505
programme.desc: En gammel bjælkehytte på en ø midt i Nordmarka får en større opgradering og bliver tilpasset nye tider.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 506
programme.desc: En gammel fiskemodtagelse på Sandøya skal have en ansigtsløftning, og de vilde kræfter fra Atlanterhavet kommer til at spille en stor rolle.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 507
programme.desc: Denne gang er teamet i gang med en traditionel hytte omgivet af mosegrønt terræn. Gustav bygger en eventyrlig vildmarksspa, mens Ole bygger borde af flere hundrede år gammelt materiale.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 508
programme.desc: En gammel folkehøjskolehytte bliver forvandlet til en familiehytte, og aldrig før har teamet foretaget en så drastisk omlægning af grundplanen.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 509
programme.desc: En gammel gård fra 1800-tallet i Trøndelag skal renoveres og moderniseres men ikke miste sin sjæl og charme. Det betyder, at Ole skal få et stykke nyt træ til at se gammelt ud.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 509
programme.desc: En gammel gård fra 1800-tallet i Trøndelag skal renoveres og moderniseres men ikke miste sin sjæl og charme. Det betyder, at Ole skal få et stykke nyt træ til at se gammelt ud.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 510
programme.desc: Ole, Gustav og Halvor renoverer hver deres fiskerhytte på Træna i Nordland. Her kommer deres konkurrencegener op til overfladen, da ejerne skal vælge, hvilken fiskerhytte de bedst kan lide.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Upon returning to work following Gina Blunt's arrest, Jane and Grayson are representing Kathy Kelton, who is suing her late fiancé Scott Richards' stepmother Caitlin over custody of his cremated remains. Though the case looks weak after Scott's sister testifies that Kathy is eating her fiancé's ashes, a sympathetic Grayson presses Jane to continue. Meanwhile, when Parker reveals that he secretly allowed the FBI to use the firm to nab Gina, Kim is angry over being kept in the dark about the sting. And as Jane starts to accept that Owen's sudden disappearance means that he's left her for another woman, she's surprised when he suddenly returns. When Kathy says that eating his ashes allows her to see Scott's ghost, Jane wonders if she would be better off getting psychological rather than legal help. But after Kathy collapses in the courtroom, she's found to be suffering from heavy metal poisoning. After tests indicate that Kathy was poisoned by a deadly chemical she ingested by eating Scott's remains, Grayson suspects that Caitlin used the substance to murder her stepson in order to inherit the $20 million he was about to receive from his father's estate. When he finally convinces Jane to listen to what he has to say, Owen explains his disappearance by revealing that he was getting checked out at the Mayo Clinic when he had a heart attack that left him in a coma for weeks. But while Jane wants to pick up where they left off, concerns about his health cause Owen to withdraw his marriage proposal. After Teri is declared the winner of a song contest, she asks Luke for a loan to finance a recording. When he looks into the record company, however, Luke discovers that Teri is the target of a con man. And when Luke takes her to a performance given by another of the contest winners, Teri learns the truth about the con. Finally, though Caitlin has already disposed of Scott's ashes, Jane tricks her into revealing what she did by claiming that Kathy kept some of the remains

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: As Jane tries to avoid aggravating Owen's heart condition, Deb's mother Bobbie Dobkins is being sued for an injury sustained by her dance student, Kiera Walsh. As she's meeting with Kiera's mom Megan, Jane is unhappy to learn that Bobbie's insurance company has assigned the pushy and annoying lawyer Simon Grundy to represent its interests. Meanwhile, Grayson's high school classmate Fiona Krupp hires him when the city of Lakewood refuses to pay her for a sculpture it commissioned and now claims is obscene. And when Luke seeks her advice about buying concert tickets for a date, Stacy assumes they are for her. Once Kiera testifies that Bobbie made her do a dance move that resulted in what Megan says is a career-ending injury, both Jane and Simon ask Bobbie to consider settling. While Jane gets Megan to consider payment for Kiera's medical costs, Simon insists that she also withdraw the claim for loss of future earnings. So when Bobbie makes matters worse by saying that Kiera would have never made it as a professional dancer, Megan angrily refuses any offer. And when she vindictively amends the lawsuit to include emotional distress, Bobbie looks to strengthen her legal team by firing Jane and hiring Parker. Meanwhile, Grayson proves that Lakewood officials approved Fiona's sketches, and Judge Owen French orders the city to pay her for the finished piece. Although Megan settles with the insurance company for Kiera's medical bills, Bobbie still remains liable for the emotional damage claim. But when Jane finds that Kiera was actually injured while skateboarding before her dance lesson, not only does the jury decide in Bobbie's favor, but the insurance company fires Simon. When Teri organizes a demonstration in support of Fiona's artwork, Owen is inspired to rule that it cannot be altered by the city. And after Fiona admits that she always intended her sculpture to be provocative in order to gain notoriety for her work, she and Grayson start a romantic relationship.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: With the support of Councilman Mark Phillips, Jane files a lawsuit on behalf of Jenny Evans, a teenager who collapsed at a rave put on by promoter Dennis Fullman. After she receives a death threat against Owen meant to dissuade her from pursuing the case, Jane opts not to tell him for fear of aggravating his heart condition. However, once Owen learns that he's under police protection and insists Jane continue with the suit, things get tougher when Jenny's friend Carla admits that they took ecstasy before the rave. Meanwhile, when Owen hesitates to invite his father to their wedding, Jane asks Stacy to investigate. After donating his sperm to Carrie Renner, Dan Abraham hires Kim and Grayson when Carrie and her new fiancé Rick Keller insist that he relinquish his parental rights. Though Keller has Dan arrested for illegally trafficking in human tissue, the case is dropped after Kim demands that anyone who engaged in a privately arranged sperm donation also be prosecuted. And when Keller accuses Dan of violating a state law that prohibits gay men from being sperm donors, Kim's contention that the government has no business dictating how people choose to get pregnant prompts Carrie to leave her bullying fiancé and negotiate visitation rights for Dan. When Jenny dies, both her mother and Carla insist that Jane pursue her case. After an autopsy shows that Jenny died from dehydration and not a drug overdose, Jane and Owen discover that the water fountains in the Coliseum were turned off, leaving the 30,000 attendees to buy bottled water from a company owned by none other than Councilman Phillips. And once Jane finds proof that he's behind the threat against Owen, Phillips is arrested for Jenny's death. Finally, Owen admits that his reluctance over the invitation stems from his disapproval of his father's recent wedding. But as Owen reconciles with his dad, Jane resists telling him the truth about her identity.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Alleging that Vanden Pharmaceuticals' antidepressant Aprox caused his client Sheila Reese to miscarry, celebrity trial lawyer Lawrence Brand arranges for Jane to help in his lawsuit. When Brand shows up late for the first day of the trial, Jane is on her own after Vanden's lawyers reveal that Sheila had been taking a dangerous painkiller while she was pregnant. And after she can't find documents that Brand claims are in the case file, Jane worries about his mental state when he becomes disoriented during his courtroom presentation. Meanwhile, Jane hesitates to tell Stacy that she'll be moving out once she and Owen find a house. Enlisting Grayson's help when Jonah Pierce claims he owns the patent on the pake, Stacy realizes that the one person who can back up her story is her ex-business partner and con artist Nikki LePree. Finding her in jail under another name, Grayson offers to keep Nikki's identity a secret in exchange for photos that prove Stacy invented the pake. But when they fail to convince the judge, Stacy and Grayson challenge Jonah to a bake-off to establish who's telling the truth. Meanwhile, when Luke decides to advance his relationship with Kim, he's surprised when she suddenly claims that she doesn't want to see him anymore. Tracking down Brand's ex-wife, Jane learns that he has a degenerative brain condition known as Pick's disease. When confronted with the truth, Brand agrees to let Jane take the lead in the lawsuit, but not before falsely claiming he has proof that Vanden knew about the dangers of Aprox. So with Owen's encouragement, Jane makes it appear as though she actually has the study's results, forcing a Vanden executive to freeze up on the witness stand. And when the company agrees to settle, Brand credits Jane for salvaging the case before announcing that he is retiring. Meanwhile, after the judge refuses to treat the Bakers' wedding vows as a legal contract, Jane and Grayson ask Dr. Alton to level with Hannah about her chances. programme.title: Charlie's Angels

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: During a return visit to the States, Jill Munroe (Farrah Fawcett) becomes involved with a wealthy and eccentric European named Eric Railman. He has flair, expensive taste, and charisma. Eric invites Jill to his yacht but their interlude is interrupted by sniper fire.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels don roller skates to investigate the disappearance of roller dance favorite, Rita Morgan. The motive, they suspect, is to prevent Rita and her dance partner Ken Satillo from winning the first place prize of $30,000 in the Fortune roller dance contest.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: A million dollars in pharmaceuticals is hijacked from a cross-country truck. The Angels are called in to help the Venus Trucking Company that employs all women drivers.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When two girls from Tiffany's sorority disappear, the Angels find themselves back in college trying to unravel a suspected white slavery ring. English professor, James Fairgate, with a reputation as a womanizer, is considered a prime suspect.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels act upon a mysterious telephone call from Charlie to come to a Diablo Island in Mexico. When they are put ashore, Wilson, the boatman, inexplicably leaves, taking their baggage and weapons. The threesome is stranded on the beach Malcolm Case, onetime convict imprisoned on Charlie's testimony, phones Charlie himself, threatening to hunt and kill the Angels one at a time until their boss arrives and exchanges himself for them. Diablo Island, they learn, is a big game preserve and the Angels must be wary of wild animals as well as of gangsters. Tiffany is thought to be drowned after attacking Wilson. Kris and Kelly set snares hoping to trap the hunters. They are successful, killing one of the henchmen. Wilson recaptures Tiffany and leaves her tied in a shack where she is ultimately freed by Kris and Kelly. Case returns to chase the Angels but is killed unexpectedly by a big cat. Knowing they are in danger of seeing Charlie (for the first time)--Bosley sends him away quickly when he arrives for the exchange. They just miss crossing paths.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Bosley and the Angels are set to transfer Charlie's 100-foot yacht, "The Wayward Angel," to Miami -- only to find it stolen and mysteriously returned.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: While visiting Erica Renny Burke, Tiffany's old college friend, the Angels are alerted to mysterious and sinister occurrences in the Burke mansion.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: While working on a robbery case, Kelly calls for police assistance when she observes the thieves escaping. A shootout occurs and one of the thieves, Joe Willow, escapes after killing a cop. Sgt. Cates takes his anger and frustration home where he batters his son, Greg. When Kelly realizes that Cates beats his son, she confronts the Sgt. and presses for child abuse charges. Joe Willow's underworld friends, Stone and Burke, observe the welfare court case awarding Kelly temporary custody of Greg while Cates works on the murder case. The thugs kidnap Kelly and Greg and attempt to persuade Cates to drop the search for Willow. Kelly manipulates her telephone answering service to alert the Angels and Cates to her house where she is being held captive. In the ensuing shootout, Kelly and Greg escape and the Angels apprehend the thugs and Willow. Cates admits his problem and is reunited with his son.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.sub-title: One Of Our Angels Is Missing
programme.desc: Bondsman Harry Silvers hires the Angels to locate accused jewel thief Ray Devlin, who has fled, jumping bail. Using a cover as a wealthy divorcee, Kris is to lure Devlin from an Arizona resort back to Los Angeles.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Tennessean Seth Jeffers follows his girlfriend, Bess Murdock, to Los Angeles and discovers she is acting in porno movies. But when Seth disappears, the Angels are called to investigate. Kelly discovers a showbill with Bess' picture and the producer's name, Joe Willis. Kris approaches Willis and the Angels find and question Bess, who knows nothing about Seth's disappearance. Willis orders the Angels killed and they barely escape death in an auto accident. Kris steals a copy of Willis' movie and upon recognizing the locale, she has police comb the area for Jeffers' body. Bess overhears Willis tell his thugs how to handle police questions about Jeffers. She confronts him, but cannot escape Joe's plans to photograph her own death on film. Kris arrives in time to interrupt the shooting and following a brief shootout, the Angels arrive to apprehend the whole crew. A shaken Bess recuperates and returns home to Tennessee.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When a wealthy Beverly Hills couple is robbed of valuable Egyptian art treasures, the Angels suspect the dapper real estate baron, Barry Kingsbrook. Kris infiltrates the Kingsbrook Agency as an agent and the Angels set up a phony house listing to lure Barry to Tiffany's supposed priceless collection of revolutionary period letters. Barry sets a deal with Bosley who poses as a wealthy collector willing to buy letters. Barry's assistant, Tina, tells him that Kris is a plant and while Tina shows Tiffany's house to prospective buyers (including the thieves) Barry takes Kris to his house where he attempts to drug her drink. The Angels capture the thieves and persuade Tina to tell where Kris is located. As the Angels arrive at Barry's house, they find that Kris has beaten Barry into confessing his role in previous thefts for money used to pay his enormous gambling debts.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: The Truth, Nothing But The Truth, So Help Me Sam

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: I, Darrin, Take This Witch Samantha
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin appear to be an ideally matched couple. Very much in love, they decide to marry. Darrin doesn't know that Samantha, is, of all things, a witch. On their wedding night, Samantha's mother, Endora, a witch, of course, visits her daughter. Regretting that her daughter has married a mortal, she is bent on breaking up the marriage. After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. After enduring Sheila's snubs and insults, Samantha cannot resist evening the score. She employs her extraordinary powers to humiliate Sheila. Later, at home, Darrin rebukes his wife, but admits Sheila deserved the tricks played on her.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora is disgusted when Samantha refuses to use supernatural powers to cope with the routine tasks of a suburban housewife.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: It Shouldn't Happen to a Dog
programme.desc: Samantha gives a dinner party to impress Rex Barker, one of Darrin's clients. Rex brings along his date, Babs Livingston, but advances on Samantha in the garden when he gets drunk.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrin struggles for days to create an advertising campaign for Caldwell Soup. Samantha's suggestions seem perfect, but Darrin's pride leads him to suspect Witchcraft. Stubborn, Darrin presents his own ideas to Phillip Caldwell, who rejects them. Samantha, worn out with housework, is stung when Darrin accuses her of using witchcraft to do that too. Endora, Samantha's mother, who dislikes Darrin, is pleased when the couple quarrels, and Samantha, packing in her own curious fashion, walks out. Crushed at losing his wife and a client in one week, Darrin submits Samantha's ideas to Larry Tate, his boss, who thinks they are great. Tate is bewildered when Darrin ecstatically accepts Caldwell's rejection and dashes home to make up with Samantha. Darrin then uses Samantha's chance remark as the basin for a successful Caldwell Soup campaign, blissfully unaware that Samantha planned it just that way.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin "Monster" Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a "Miss Jasmine" for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is "Miss Jasmine." Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the "Miss Jasmine" campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of "Miss Jasmine" into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Larry and Louise Tate have been married for sixteen years and have no children. Louise asks Samantha to go with her to an obstetrician as tests have shown she is going to be a mother. Louise tells Samantha she is afraid to tell Larry since she believes he hates children. Larry, visiting his dentist at the medical center, sees Louise and Samantha enter the obstetrician's office. Thinking Samantha is going to have a baby, he tells Darrin, but cautions him not to say anything until Samantha tells him. In a reverie, Darrin visualizes his children as little witches. He comes to with a sinking feeling. Samantha invites the Tates to dinner. Both Larry and Darrin hover over Samantha, warning her not to exert herself. Louise is all but forgotten, but makes several unsuccessful attempts to tell Larry that he is to be a father. Finally, Samantha tells Larry. He is overjoyed. Although Darrin doesn't tell Samantha about his reverie, he is reassured when she tells him she hopes they have a child who looks just like him.

programme.sub-title: The Truth, Nothing But The Truth, So Help Me Sam

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: I, Darrin, Take This Witch Samantha
programme.desc: Samantha and Darrin appear to be an ideally matched couple. Very much in love, they decide to marry. Darrin doesn't know that Samantha, is, of all things, a witch. On their wedding night, Samantha's mother, Endora, a witch, of course, visits her daughter. Regretting that her daughter has married a mortal, she is bent on breaking up the marriage. After pleading with her mother not to interfere, Samantha decides to tell her husband that he has unknowingly married a witch. To convince Darrin of her magic powers, Samantha performs a series of tricks. Darrin makes her promise never to practice her witchcraft again. Sheila, a former girl friend of Darrin's, invites the newly-weds to a dinner party. She makes every effort to embarrass Samantha before the guests. After enduring Sheila's snubs and insults, Samantha cannot resist evening the score. She employs her extraordinary powers to humiliate Sheila. Later, at home, Darrin rebukes his wife, but admits Sheila deserved the tricks played on her.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Endora is disgusted when Samantha refuses to use supernatural powers to cope with the routine tasks of a suburban housewife.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: It Shouldn't Happen to a Dog
programme.desc: Samantha gives a dinner party to impress Rex Barker, one of Darrin's clients. Rex brings along his date, Babs Livingston, but advances on Samantha in the garden when he gets drunk.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz, a neighbor, is unable to convince her husband, Abner, that strange things seem to be happening at the Stephens' home. Gladys, June Foster, and Shirley Clyde, with their sons, visit the Stephens' home to welcome Samantha to the community. Gladys is frustrated in her attempts to point out to her friends the amazing number of objects which seem to appear and disappear. When the boys pester Endora, Samantha's mother, she uses magic to tie the three of them up. On leaving, Gladys tries to point out to her friends that it would be physically impossible for three boys to tie themselves up. Later Darrin returns home for his first meeting with Endora. Endora and Darrin soon engage in a heated argument about their opposing viewpoints on life. Endora threatens to turn Darrin into as artichoke. Later Samantha expresses her love for Darrin by announcing that if Endora had done so, she would also have turned herself into an artichoke.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.
